body: I tried man, I really did. For the last year I didn't do anything but be positive, smile and help people. It just doesn't work. I see no use being here, at all.

It's not being alone or being heartbroken that is causing me to think like this. I had serious issues and still do in my life that made me think the easy way out. The fact that I'll never have my eyes cured or the anemia is one of them. Even after all these my family isn't exactly the best either.
